# teams_messaging_policy (Resource)

Manages the MessagingPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy / Get-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy / Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy.
